input.summary: Add a Section 5.5 ownership clause: Company owns the Site, deliverables and customer data; HDI retains background IP and grants a perpetual licence back; no joint ownership.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no ownership provision, so we have added one confirming that we own the Site, the Content and the customer data generated through it, consistent with our playbook that we own what we pay for and everything we put in. HDI keeps its pre-existing platform and tools and grants us a perpetual, royalty-free licence to anything of its own embedded in the Site.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company shall own all right, title and interest in and to the Site (including the Content and the design and look and feel of the Site), all deliverables and work product created for the Company under this Agreement, and all customer data and user information collected through the Site, and HDI hereby assigns to the Company all such right, title and interest. HDI shall retain all right, title and interest in and to its pre-existing software, systems, tools and know-how, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense any such HDI materials incorporated into the Site or any deliverable for the Company's business purposes. Nothing in this Agreement shall create any joint ownership of intellectual property or operate as an assignment to HDI of any of the Company's intellectual property, Content or customer data.
